wikipedia.pt: Guerra civil dos Armagnacs e Borguinhões

title: Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War", at revision 1373244141, opens: "The Armagnac–Burgundian Civil War was a conflict between two cadet branches of the French royal family: the House of Orléans and the House of Burgundy from 1407 to 1435. It began during a lull in the Hundred Years' War against the English and overlapped with the Western Schism of the papacy." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1021160, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "French civil war between the Armagnac and Burgundian factions". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
